raw_response: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating the area of vineyards in thousands of hectares for several countries from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, labeled as "Години" (Years), with a linear scale and evenly spaced intervals of one year. The vertical axis represents the area in thousands of hectares, labeled as "Хиллади хектари" (Thousands of hectares), ranging from 0 to 1200, with a linear scale and evenly spaced intervals of 200. There are seven countries represented by different colored bars: Spain (blue), France (orange), China/continental (light blue), Italy (yellow), Turkey (green), USA (teal), and Argentina (dark blue). In 2013, Spain has the highest area, approximately 900 thousand hectares, while Argentina has the lowest, around 200 thousand hectares. In 2022, Spain still has the highest area, around 860 thousand hectares, and Turkey has the lowest, approximately 220 thousand hectares. The height of the bars varies across years and countries, showing changes in vineyard area over time.
